what_was_done.action: Wrapped repeat-dispatch-escalation.ts act() with dispatch-preconditions gate
what_was_done.result: After snapshot re-read and BEFORE the action-route fetch, act() builds DispatchContext + evaluates preconditions. Refusal → structured warn-log tagged reconciler_dispatch_refused + reconciler-action-refused event (Wave-1 variant) + early return without dispatching.

After fetch, if res.status === 412 → warn-log tagged reconciler_dispatch_refused_at_route + reconciler-action-refused event with refusalCode=ROUTE_REFUSED_412 + return WITHOUT throwing. Distinguishes route-side refusal from genuine HTTP failure (which would propagate as an act() error and trigger different recovery).

what_was_done.action: Added optional repoPath option to RepeatDispatchEscalationRuleOptions
what_was_done.result: Mirrors stuck-in-stage.ts (ehp.5) pattern: repoPath optional for backwards-compat with pre-ehp.8 tests; when absent, gate falls open with warn-line and pre-ehp.8 behaviour preserved. Bootstrap passes production repoPath unconditionally so production path is fully gated.

src/lib/reconciler-bootstrap.ts updated to pass repoPath to buildRepeatDispatchEscalationRule, activating the gate in production. Without this 1-line addition the gate would be dormant in production and the bead would ship cosmetically only.
what_was_done.evidence: src/lib/reconciler-bootstrap.ts (added repoPath: repoPath in the rule options block, after appendSuppressedEvent)

recommendation_for_next: Reviewer should verify: (1) the integration test follows the marker-driven-routing.precondition-integration.test.ts pattern exactly (it does — same mock structure, same assertion pattern, same module-boundary mocking); (2) the bootstrap wiring is correct (1-line addition of repoPath: repoPath in the existing rule options block); (3) the optional-repoPath choice mirrors stuck-in-stage.ts ehp.5 (it does — copied the same doc-comment + warn-line phrasing); (4) the FOLLOW-ON note about refusals consuming the reconciler-action-taken idempotency bucket (architecture ADR-006) applies here too and is already tracked as a separate reconciler-core bead in marker-driven-routing.ts's docstring.
surprises_or_findings: Two scope deviations from the literal FILES manifest, surfaced rather than hidden per STOP-and-surface discipline: (1) src/lib/reconciler-bootstrap.ts (1-line addition: pass repoPath to enable the gate in production — without this the bead ships cosmetic code with the gate dormant); (2) ARCHITECTURE.md (new subsection per project rule that mandates ARCHITECTURE.md updates in the same commit when a feature/component changes). Both are mechanically required for the bead's load-bearing intent. The optional-repoPath choice avoided modifying the existing repeat-dispatch-escalation.test.ts (~15 buildRepeatDispatchEscalationRule calls would have needed the repoPath field added). Pre-existing in-flight Wave-3/Wave-4 work in the working tree (stuck-in-stage.precondition-integration.test.ts, wave-bead-mismatch.precondition-integration.test.ts) has 8 failing tests — confirmed pre-existing, NOT introduced by this change.
whats_open: Refusal events still consume the reconciler-action-taken idempotency bucket per architecture ADR-006; proper bucketing key (epicId, ruleName, refusalCode, 15-min window) requires a reconciler.ts core change tracked separately. Same FOLLOW-ON noted for marker-driven-routing.ts/ehp.4 and stuck-in-stage.ts/ehp.5.

API tightening opportunity: making repoPath REQUIRED on RepeatDispatchEscalationRuleOptions (vs the current optional-with-warn) would force-error any future caller that forgets to wire it. Deferred to avoid mechanical updates to ~15 existing test calls (out-of-manifest scope).
